On this record, compliant_with_caveats would require admissible evidence that the material limitation is actually disclosed, formally determined immaterial, or covered by approved risk acceptance. None of that was added. The Actor's clarification improves characterization of the claim but does not close the unresolved compliance defects identified in the initial audit.
